target.title: fix(cli): suppress mcp serve startup stdout
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where stdio MCP clients launching `openclaw mcp serve` could receive doctor or config-warning text on stdout before JSON-RPC messages, causing protocol parse failures.

## Why This Change Was Made

`mcp serve` now uses the existing stdout-clean CLI startup policy. This routes startup diagnostics away from protocol stdout before config preflight runs, while leaving other non-JSON commands unchanged.

The focused regression covers the complete startup-policy result for `["mcp", "serve"]`.

## User Impact

MCP clients can launch OpenClaw's stdio server without non-JSON startup output corrupting the protocol stream.

## Evidence

- Original live reproduction:
  - before: `openclaw mcp serve` emitted 740 stdout bytes of config-warning output
  - after: startup emitted 0 stdout bytes
  - affected clients stopped accumulating fresh `Failed to parse JSONRPC message` errors after restart
- Rebased onto current `main` with the original two-file behavior preserved.
- Static validation:
  - `git diff --check`
  - `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/cli/command-startup-policy.ts src/cli/command-startup-policy.test.ts`
- Fresh structured autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Fresh exact-head hosted Ubuntu CI is running on `bfa3bf4caa80a44f64918eaabbb6198a590acb11`.

AI-assisted maintainer rebase/review; the contributor's PR and credit are preserved.
